correctness.rationale: For cubic M_n on 2n vertices n>=3, the complement bits in a twisted two-row ladder satisfy two exact local inequalities a_r+c_r+b_{1−r}<=1+b_r, encoding both 1-limited and domination conditions. The 16-state weighted transfer T(u) with row-swap S counts labelled allowed complements as tr(T(u)^nS). Its 10- and 6-dimensional ± blocks have the displayed exact integer polynomial determinant identities, with trace–log giving every coefficient of the closed generating function. Counting edges in the cut gives |D|>=n. Extracting constant and linear terms in z gives min n if 4|n else n+1, with multiplicities 4,2n (n≡2 mod4),3n (n odd). Independently brute-enumerated all labelled subsets for n=3,...,8: predicted minima/multiplicities (4,9),(4,4),(6,15),(7,12),(8,21),(8,4); the unbounded result depends on the symbolic transfer argument, not finite sampling.
